name: NovelMark — Multi-Site Reading Tracker
description: Tracks your reading position and chapter progress across webnovel/fanfiction sites and long-form articles in one unified list.

_permission_justifications.storage: Stores reading positions (URL, scroll %, chapter title) and plan status in chrome.storage.local. Nothing is sent to an external server except an anonymous paid-status check.
_permission_justifications.activeTab: Used only when the user opens the popup and clicks 'Track this page' — reads the URL/title of the currently active tab and messages that tab's already-injected content script. No background access to arbitrary tabs.
_permission_justifications.content_scripts_matches: The broad http/https matches let a passive script detect Royal Road / Webnovel / AO3 chapters and long-form articles (via an <article>/paragraph-length heuristic) and record scroll position locally. It makes no network requests and stays inert on pages that are not a recognized chapter or long-form article.
